Settings.AllowNegative: Allow selling items with no stock on record
Settings.AutoBackup: Back up automatically (and after each shift closes)
Settings.BackupDoubleClick: Double-click a backup to show its file
Settings.BackupFileNotHere: This backup file isn't on this PC: {0}. It is kept on the PC that runs SQL Server, or it was removed by the 30-day cleanup.
Settings.BackupFolder: Backup folder on the SQL Server PC (empty = server default)
Settings.BackupFolderNotHere: The backup folder isn't on this PC: {0}. Backups are saved on the PC that runs SQL Server.
Settings.BackupHint: SQL Server writes backups on its own PC, so the folder must be writable by the SQL Server service. Use a cloud-synced or network folder so a copy survives if that PC fails. Every backup is kept in its own file; automatic ones older than 30 days are removed. Backups are safe to take while tills are selling.
Settings.LbpHint: Prices stay in dollars. Pound amounts the customer pays are rounded up to this step; change and refunds in pounds are rounded down. Managers can also change the rate from the top bar, and every change is logged.
Settings.LoyaltyHint: Points are earned on cash, card and wallet payments, and can be redeemed at checkout.
Settings.PrintLogoOnReceipt: Print the store logo at the top of receipts
Settings.PrintLogoOnReceiptHint: Sale and return receipts. Uses the logo set under Store logo; a simple black-and-white logo prints best on receipt printers.
